question: Which isolation contract should memory-wiki use for shared-gateway multi-agent setups?
rationale: The choice affects sensitive memory visibility, plugin config/API shape, prompt/corpus/tool routing, and how CLI or gateway calls without agent context behave.

options.title: Plugin-owned vault isolation
options.body: Let memory-wiki resolve an effective vault per agent/session/context with explicit no-context behavior and coordinate later with generic plugin overrides.

options.title: Wait for generic plugin overrides
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on a broader `agents.list[].plugins` or equivalent configuration surface such as #55401.

options.title: Document unsupported isolation
options.body: State that shared-gateway memory-wiki isolation is unsupported and require separate gateways or separate plugin installations for sensitive vaults.

recommendation.title: Plugin-owned vault isolation
recommendation.body: Let memory-wiki resolve an effective vault per agent/session/context with explicit no-context behavior and coordinate later with generic plugin overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product/security config-boundary decision more than a local memory-wiki implementation detail.
